editing: NativeLibrary.FCStd contains 21 named archetypes, not thousands of assembly instances.
Each Parameters_* node has editable dimensions; boxes, cylinders, cones and native booleans use expressions.
Footprint cell counts are read-only topology choices; select another archetype to change the grid.
Select the named Final object when exporting. Construction features are retained intentionally.
Archetypes share their local body-bottom-center origin and are not spatially laid out in the native library.
All files were reopened in a separate headless process, forcibly recomputed, dimension-edited, and restored.
FCStd files require no Python proxy module when reopened.
limitations: Uncalibrated PLA / P1S / 0.4 mm nozzle assumptions; no coupons or kit parts have been physically printed.
Physical fit is UNKNOWN. Production export remains BLOCKED; these native/STL files are prototype studies, not a print-ready kit.
Pitch-4 lateral wall is 0.876667 mm, BELOW the 1.2 mm reference minimum; it is not silently enlarged or passed.
Coupon minimum wall is 1.31 mm and material below the open wells is 2.03 mm.
A single round-stud 1x1 brick has UNPROVEN rotational constraint; multi-stud patterns constrain rotation nominally only.
The five-position coupon insertion check is idealized BRep interference testing, not a physical fit calibration.
No commercial-brick compatibility, logos, or branding is claimed. No slicer, G-code, or printer communication was used.
archive_scope: Historical native geometry checks, not physical fit, retention, or production approval.
public_copy_note: Execution receipts, machine paths and runtime details excluded; use archive/inventory.json for public hashes.
